title: ENDURANCE A · BUILD THE ENGINE
emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed.

deposits.title: STEADY ENDURANCE

exercises.name: Steady treadmill or outdoor walk
exercises.cue: Keep a pace that lets you speak complete sentences.
exercises.prescription: 35 min moderate continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.
exercises.home: 35 min moderate continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.

deposits.effort: 35 min at a conversational pace. Start with 20–25 min if this exceeds recent capacity.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: ACTIVE MOBILITY

exercises.name: Cat-cow + quadruped rock-back
exercises.cue: Move gently with your breathing. Keep every position comfortable.
exercises.prescription: Alternate slow cat-cow and comfortable quadruped rock-backs. Split the allotted time equally. Pad knees or use a standing, hands-on-chair version if preferred. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Alternate slow cat-cow and comfortable quadruped rock-backs. Split the allotted time equally. Pad knees or use a standing, hands-on-chair version if preferred. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

exercises.name: Iron Neck · easy control
exercises.home: Optional: 2 min of familiar, light controlled neck work. Substitute open books if uncomfortable or setup is a hassle. Demo unavailable.
exercises.cue: Small comfortable range; no ballistic motion or strain.

deposits.effort: Comfortable active range; stop anything painful. No forced stretching.
deposits.label: B

levels.bonus: Optional brisk walk; dummy lab separate

weekSummary: Mon strength A · Tue endurance · Wed strength B · Thu endurance · Fri strength C · Sat boxing · Sun recovery

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · TOP-POSITION CONTROL
martialSupplement.home: Review a familiar stable top position with the dummy. Pause to inspect base and points of contact; reset gently and compare. Study only, without hard pressure or submission finishing. Focus: Can I explain which contacts keep the position stable while I move?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
